ctx.x: Did you ever get to meet him?

Yes, I eventually met him after -- in latter days, you know, just acquaintance type. Jack, I want to introduce you to Jimmie Lunsford's drummer, Jimmy -- James Crawford, I was going under. It was a pleasure seeing that old champ.
What kind of a guy was he?
